scope: Twenty official scheduled core EIPs; evidence rows are not completion percentages.

core.title: Resource-based intrinsic gas
core.requirements_reviewed: State-independent validity; decomposed sender/recipient/value costs; runtime authorization/account OOG is an included failure.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus, sender/self/creation and pre-execution regression tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: No additional deviation confirmed.

core.title: ProgressiveContainer
core.requirements_reviewed: Immutable active_fields, four illegal layouts, Container wire identity, active-word mix-in and stable gindices.
core.executed_evidence: Independent 29-container/1016-field/487-list corpus and actual captured CL state run inside full Go suite.
core.finding_or_boundary: Deprecated compatibility helpers are separate from normative schemas.

core.title: Forward-compatible CL structures
core.requirements_reviewed: Converted container/list shapes and runtime bounds; immutable Validator and history accumulators remain unchanged.
core.executed_evidence: 345 CL type tests; four captured/progressive checks; actual captured state matches the unchanged selected consensus reference.
core.finding_or_boundary: No fresh complete upstream per-type/per-fork CL fixture replay; see G02.

core.title: ETH transfer logs
core.requirements_reviewed: Exact emitter/topic/amount, chronological transfer logs, no zero/self/fee/withdrawal logs, rollback removes reverted logs.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and full VM/Node integration suites.
core.finding_or_boundary: No additional deviation confirmed.

core.title: ePBS
core.requirements_reviewed: Signed bid/envelope authority, request root, single beacon post-state and deferred parent processing; payments/withdrawals and builder registry.
core.executed_evidence: 67 CL state-processing tests, 4 fork-choice and 41 proto-array tests; includes 23 builder-family cases. Actual crypto, mock execution endpoints.
core.finding_or_boundary: Not a fresh full fork-choice/gossip fixture or live independent-peer campaign; G02/G03 remain.

core.title: Gross block gas
core.requirements_reviewed: User refund remains; execution block dimension uses pre-refund gas/floor while state refills remain net; header max and receipt sum differ.
core.executed_evidence: EIP7778 and builder/replay/gas-pool tests plus complete signed state corpora.
core.finding_or_boundary: State corpus alone cannot establish block header/receipt/BAL conformance; G01.

core.title: SLOTNUM
core.requirements_reviewed: Opcode 0x4b, cost 2; uint64 from CL committed in the header and carried over Engine API.
core.executed_evidence: Native state corpus plus actual Engine HTTP, independent Geth header, canonical RPC, opcode and restart regression.
core.finding_or_boundary: F01: valid uppercase/mixed-case quantity digits rejected before fix; corrected in PR160.

core.title: ProgressiveList
core.requirements_reviewed: Progressive 1/4/16/64 subtrees, empty termination, basic packing/bit packing and element-count mix-in, stable proof paths.
core.executed_evidence: Independent corpus and full SSZ race suites; shared gindex repair from merged PR159 retained.
core.finding_or_boundary: Chunk-root encoder helpers are not a general typed serializer; ordinary typed codecs still own field encoding.

core.title: Block access lists
core.requirements_reviewed: Minimal integer RLP, phase indices, ordering/uniqueness, pre/post-state OOG accesses, final transaction diffs, commitment and retention.
core.executed_evidence: Native state corpus plus actual block build/import, system transitions, raw BAL/retention and reconciliation tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: No native official blockchain/BAL corpus replay tool was found; G01.

core.title: Code/initcode limits
core.requirements_reviewed: 65536-byte code and 131072-byte initcode limits with fork gating and creation failure semantics.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and VM/transaction creation boundary tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: No additional deviation confirmed.

core.title: Calldata floor
core.requirements_reviewed: 64 gas for every zero/nonzero byte; decomposed base from EIP2780; validity/settlement and block execution floor.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and RPC/txpool/execution tests in full/race suites.
core.finding_or_boundary: Older named gas helpers are not the canonical Amsterdam path; G04.

core.title: Access-list data surcharge
core.requirements_reviewed: Flat 64 gas per address/key byte enters both intrinsic and floor; access charge remains separate with EIP8038 repricing.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and actual processor/txpool tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: No additional deviation confirmed in the active path.

core.title: Deterministic factory
core.requirements_reviewed: Exact address/runtime and nonzero nonce via explicit genesis/deployment; no fork-boundary injection or existence check.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and explicit genesis/runtime/system tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: Network allocation policy is separate from an EL fork-boundary validity check.

core.title: Deep stack opcodes
core.requirements_reviewed: Exact decoding/reserved immediate ranges, zero-padding at EOF, stack bounds and unchanged JUMPDEST analysis.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and 672 directly named passing Go test events.
core.finding_or_boundary: Current source differs from prior pin only in editorial step numbering/cross-reference.

core.title: State gas reservoir
core.requirements_reviewed: Fixed CPSB1530; per-dimension inclusion; LIFO charge/refill, baseline rollback, committed authorizations, creation/collision and system margin.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus; complete affected/broad race suites and actual system-state margin tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: Whole-block official corpus remains separate; G01. Deferred 48h is not reclassified as a pass.

core.title: State access/write pricing
core.requirements_reviewed: Cold account3000, access-list2900/2000, storage write10000, clear refund11616; writes and delegation/pre-state access order.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus and full VM/transaction/BAL suites.
core.finding_or_boundary: Obsolete experimental gas-table helpers still carry misleading names/comments; G04.

core.title: Exclude slashed proposers
core.requirements_reviewed: Filter before shuffling; preserve existing current/next lookahead; compute only at the decision slot.
core.executed_evidence: Actual unchanged CL library matches 96 independently selected indices across three slashing distributions; cached lookahead unchanged; out-of-window request rejected.
core.finding_or_boundary: Derived captured-state helper test, not a new live mass-slashing campaign.

core.title: Exit/consolidation churn
core.requirements_reviewed: 32768 exit quotient, activation cap256 ETH, independent consolidation65536 quotient, increment rounding and asymmetric weak-subjectivity formula.
core.executed_evidence: Ten independent literal-EIP expectations against actual CL helper methods, including cap/rounding boundaries and 36M/120M ETH aggregate inputs.
core.finding_or_boundary: Large totals are explicitly injected cache inputs for helper testing, not network-scale state acceptance.

core.title: No SELFDESTRUCT burn
core.requirements_reviewed: Same-transaction self-beneficiary retains balance; finalization clears nonce/code/storage, preserves later credits, and EIP161 removes empty result.
core.executed_evidence: Native signed corpus plus 31 directly named passing Go events and backend/restart integration tests.
core.finding_or_boundary: No additional deviation confirmed.

core.title: Builder requests
core.requirements_reviewed: Exact runtime/address, fees/inhibitor/caps/endian request bus; mandatory system call, rollback, BLS deposit domain and exit source authorization.
core.executed_evidence: Full EL suites plus actual CL builder registry/wire/payment tests in the 67-case CL suite.
core.finding_or_boundary: No dedicated EIP8282 cases occur by path in the selected EELS state corpus; do not count that corpus as independent contract acceptance. G01/G02. G05: top-up prose versus detailed prefix precondition differs, reproduced in both actual client and current independent reference; no unilateral CL consensus change.
